inlines.text: 이 페이지는 전투·지휘·부대 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(kernel-then-owned-health-and-conservation): Approved severity policy alone maps contest/context to one injury cause/loss ID; D02 settles once, D15 sums unique receipts, no second damage. All actually arrived eligible ongoing participants admitted, capacity pressure never blocks arrival.

blocks.text:
REF-ROLL [] target=base+known modifiers; critical3/4,5 if target>=15,6 if>=16; fail17/18; critical fail18,17 if<=15,or roll-target>=10; ordinary target<3 disallowed; defense exception
REF-DEFENSE [] dodge=floor((DX+HT)/4+3)-encumbrance+approvedModifiers; parry=floor(3+weaponSkill/2); block=floor(3+ShieldSkill/2)
REF-INJURY [] basic=max(type==cr?0:1,sum(dice)+adds); p=max(0,basic-DR); injury=p==0?0:max(1,floor(p*multiplier))
LOSS-SUM [] unitInjury=sum(unique individual result injury); each action-target exactly one writer
EXCESS [] excess=max(0,count(memberIds)-capacity); memberIdsAfter=memberIdsBefore
CAPACITY [proposal-held] null
D15-F1 [후보·승인 전] personalOutcome=selectedKernel(valid personal inputs); injuryEvent=severityPolicy(weapon,protection,contact,personalOutcome); emit one cause/loss id; no imported penetration multiplier
D15-F2 [후보·승인 전] unitLoss=sum(distinct personal loss receipts); no second damage from aggregation; mayJoin=verifiedArrival && ongoing
D15-F3 [후보·승인 전] commandPressure=max(0,commandLoad-commandCapacity); informs separate command policy, never deletes members or prevents actual arrivals

inlines.text: D15의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: worldTime — finite nonnegative number (world elapsed unit from D18)
numericCombatInput — approved record or reference fixture (skill/DR/basic-damage/HP separately)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 GDD-design; campaign owns instances; WIKI authored facts read-only; presentation no writes, 유지 계약은 LOSS-SUM·EXCESS다. 상태 소유 경계는 actor/defense assignments,equipment/contact,action+target,cause/loss receipts,D02 condition state,actual arrivals,members,command load/capacity. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_EXTERNAL_ORDER, E_CONSERVATION
기존 평가기 오류: E_HELD_VALUE, E_TYPE, E_RANGE, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_DICE, E_UNIT, E_DAMAGE_TYPE, E_NOT_COVERED, E_AUTHORITY, E_IMPOSSIBLE_ORDER

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: REF-ROLL, REF-DEFENSE, REF-INJURY. Remove call/dependency from original operative consumer, not original records/historical references/tests.

items.text: approved range validator only; kernel does not invoke it
pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
signed side assembly, exact cause/effect duplicate/unit/range checks, no effects source resolver
caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D15-personal-contest-loss-adapter(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/personal-contest-loss-adapter.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/personal-contest-loss-adapter.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
